# dask_grid_over_atoms { #mofography.compute.dask_grid_over_atoms }

```python
compute.dask_grid_over_atoms(ase_atoms, spacing=0.1, chunksize=50000)
```

Generate a dask array of grid points over an ase atoms object with a specified grid spacing

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type              | Description                                                              | Default    |
|-----------|-------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| ase_atoms | ase.atoms obj     | ASE atoms object                                                         | _required_ |
| spacing   | (float, optional) | grid fineness in angstroms, defaults to 0.1                              | `0.1`      |
| chunksize | (int, optional)   | number of grid points in each block of the dask array, defaults to 50000 | `50000`    |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                                |
|--------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dask.array | dask array of size (N_grid_points, 3) with each block of size 'chunksize'. |
